description: This file defines a display driver class for a custom content field in OrchardCore, specifically for localization set content picker fields. It includes methods for displaying, editing, and updating the field, and references various OrchardCore modules and services.

classes.name: LocalizationSetContentPickerFieldDisplayDriver
classes.description: A display driver class for rendering and managing localization set content picker fields within OrchardCore.

methods.name: Display
methods.description: Generates the display shape for the localization set content picker field.

methods.name: Edit
methods.description: Prepares the edit shape for the localization set content picker field, including loading selected items.

methods.name: UpdateAsync
methods.description: Handles the update process for the localization set content picker field, validating and saving changes.
